sloka: वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्न च मेऽद्य चलिष्यति ।यस्तुष्टेन वरो दत्तः कैकेय्यै वरद त्वया ॥२-३४-४२॥
transliteration: vanavāsakṛtā buddhirna ca me'dya caliṣyati ।yastuṣṭena varo dattaḥ kaikeyyai varada tvayā ॥2-34-42॥

translations.english: My decision to go to the forest remains unchanged. O bestower of boons, O king honour to the last word the boons you had granted Kaikeyi. And adhere to truth.
